systems.system: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique
systems.country_label: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique
systems.owner: an organisme en charge de l'identifiant unique, to be created by decree; a designated public structure meanwhile
systems.tiers: central database of unique identifiers with biographic and biometric data; birth-certificate references are optional enrolment data (law n°027-2024/ALT of 11 October 2024, promulgated 28 October 2024)

note: The law on unique electronic identification: an identity register, with the birth certificate's references an optional field; nothing on civil registration offices or how they record events.
